_doc: Prices per million tokens, in USD. 'fuente' (source) says where each figure comes from. A null price is not verified: that model's cost is not reported.

anthropic:claude-haiku-5-5.fuente: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (retrieved 2026-10-26). 'in' and 'out' are the tier for prompts up to 100,000 tokens; above it, each request pays 0.50 for input and 2.50 for output. Every run in the repository stays below the threshold.

gemini:gemini-3.8-flash.fuente: Google, https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (retrieved 2026-10-22). Valid until December 31, 2026; from January 1, 2027 it rises to 1.50 / 7.50.

anthropic:claude-haiku-4-5-20251001.fuente: semana-19/costos/precios.json (haiku45_entrada_1m 1.1, haiku45_salida_1m 5.5; Price List API, Claude Haiku 4.5, retrieved 2026-11-13, mark M). The tier above 100,000 tokens is NOT verified for Haiku 4.5: the same price is assumed; the agent's runs stay far below 100,000 tokens.
